title: Fresh checkout cannot build u-nesting-d2 due to missing path dependencies
body:
Hi, I tried evaluating U-Nesting as a candidate dependency for an in-app 2D nesting feature and could not build the current published/source package because the workspace references local path dependencies that are not present in the repo or published to crates.io.

Repro from a fresh checkout:

```sh
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/iyulab/U-Nesting /tmp/U-Nesting
cd /tmp/U-Nesting
cargo tree -p u-nesting-d2
cargo check -p u-nesting-d2
```

Observed on current `main`:

```text
HEAD=653acdae930c150e293792875eb1ef85b925ffa1
workspace version=0.3.1

error: failed to load manifest for workspace member `/private/tmp/.../U-Nesting/crates/core`
referenced by workspace at `/private/tmp/.../U-Nesting/Cargo.toml`

Caused by:
  failed to load manifest for dependency `u-geometry`

Caused by:
  failed to read `/private/tmp/algorithms/u-geometry/Cargo.toml`

Caused by:
  No such file or directory (os error 2)
```

The missing dependencies appear in `crates/core/Cargo.toml`:

```toml
u-metaheur = { version = "0.2", path = "../../../../algorithms/u-metaheur" }
u-numflow = { version = "0.2", path = "../../../../foundation/u-numflow" }
u-geometry = { version = "0.1", path = "../../../../algorithms/u-geometry" }
```

The crates.io package `u-nesting-d2` currently has only `0.1.0` published, and that published version was also not usable for the same class of missing private path dependency.

Would you be able to publish or include the required dependencies, or update the workspace to depend on public crates so `cargo tree -p u-nesting-d2` and `cargo check -p u-nesting-d2` work from a fresh clone?
